message.content:
This appears to be a CBP ruling on black garlic. The candidate headings are 0703.20 (fresh or chilled garlic), 0710.80 (frozen vegetables), 0711.90 (provisionally preserved vegetables), 0712.90 (dried vegetables), and 2005.99 (other vegetables prepared or preserved otherwise than by vinegar, not frozen).

The garlic is fermented, then dried again and vacuum packed. It is not simply dried garlic, because the Maillard browning and enzymatic changes make it a different product. Dried garlic under 0712.90 covers garlic that has only been dried, whether whole, cut, or powdered, and that is not further prepared. The black garlic is further processed, and it is imported refrigerated in vacuum pouches, ready to eat as a snack. That points to 2005.99, where the garlic subheading is 2005.99.9700 ("other vegetables"). Within 2005.99, the 2005.99.20 and .40 lines cover specific items, and garlic is not among them. I recall that CBP ruling N-numbers for black garlic classified it in 2005.99.9700, so I will use that.

The HTSUS 2005.99 breakdown is:
- 2005.99.10: Artichokes
- 2005.99.20: Asparagus
- 2005.99.25: Carrots
- 2005.99.40: Mixtures
- 2005.99.50: Pimientos
- 2005.99.60: Sauerkraut
- 2005.99.80: Other
- 2005.99.9100 and following: other, with 2005.99.9700 being "Other" within that group

I'll go with 2005.99.9700.
